title: fea.plot
summary: Create a RunMat figure for a FEA result field.
description: `fea.plot` creates a RunMat figure from a contextual run, results object, field object, or explicit study/run pair.
behaviors: Supported forms are `fea.plot(run, fieldId)`, `fea.plot(results, fieldId)`, `fea.plot(field)`, and `fea.plot(study, runId, fieldId)`; `Field` or `FieldId` may select the field where applicable.
Study geometry context and a persisted run id must be available before figure generation starts.
The returned figure handle uses RunMat's conventional double scripting representation. Numeric arrays are not accepted as handles, run identifiers, or field identifiers.
A requested device-backed field is rejected with a targeted error until it is explicitly materialized on the host; the field is never silently omitted or gathered through an unrelated provider.
Plot generation uses existing study mesh and result artifacts and does not intrinsically require native OCCT or numeric provider dispatch.

faqs.question: Does plotting re-import CAD?
faqs.answer: No. It uses geometry context already carried by the study or derived result object.
